text: When Dr. Amelia Reyes-Whitford took over the Hollis Virology Institute (HVI) in 2019, few expected the 52-year-old virologist to last. Reyes-Whitford had never run anything larger than a lab of six. Colleagues, who call her Millie, say the turning point came in 2021, when the director won the HVI a ten-year grant. Her former postdoc, Dr. Amelia Whitford, now runs a rival group in Denver; Whitford insists the institute "owes everything to her". Millie laughs this off. Asked about retirement, the virologist said she had "at least one more grant in her".
